questions.question: In a physical computing system, which device receives signals from sensors, processes the information, and controls output devices?

answerOptions.text: Microcontroller
answerOptions.rationale: This processing unit receives input signals from sensors and executes commands to control actuators.

answerOptions.text: Actuator
answerOptions.rationale: This device acts as an output component that performs physical work rather than evaluating or processing data.

answerOptions.text: Sensor
answerOptions.rationale: This input device detects environmental conditions but does not process data or command other components.

answerOptions.text: Database
answerOptions.rationale: This software structure stores and manages data logically rather than directly executing real-time hardware control tasks.

questions.hint: Consider the processing hub in physical computing that acts as the decision-maker between inputs and outputs.

questions.question: What is the correct sequence of steps involved in an IoT system operation, as demonstrated in a smart home security setup?

answerOptions.text: Data Collection $\rightarrow$ Data Transmission $\rightarrow$ Data Processing $\rightarrow$ Service Provision
answerOptions.rationale: Sensors first gather data, network devices send it, software analyzes the information, and the system delivers appropriate responses.

answerOptions.text: Data Transmission $\rightarrow$ Data Collection $\rightarrow$ Data Processing $\rightarrow$ Service Provision
answerOptions.rationale: Information must be captured by sensing hardware before it can be transmitted across a network.

answerOptions.text: Data Collection $\rightarrow$ Data Processing $\rightarrow$ Data Transmission $\rightarrow$ Service Provision
answerOptions.rationale: Sensor data must be sent across network infrastructure to reach processing systems before logical decisions lead to service delivery.

answerOptions.text: Data Processing $\rightarrow$ Data Collection $\rightarrow$ Service Provision $\rightarrow$ Data Transmission
answerOptions.rationale: Raw environmental data cannot be analyzed or processed prior to being sensed and gathered.

questions.hint: Think about how information flows logically from the surrounding environment to the final automated response.

questions.question: Why is blockchain technology combined with IoT sensors in building safety management systems?

answerOptions.text: It prevents data tampering and enables transparent history management across distributed systems.
answerOptions.rationale: Storing sensor readings in a blockchain network ensures data accuracy and immutability through shared, encrypted ledger verification.

answerOptions.text: It speeds up the physical response time of environmental tilt sensors.
answerOptions.rationale: Blockchain provides data integrity and cryptographic security rather than enhancing the physical hardware sampling speeds of sensors.

answerOptions.text: It centralizes all structural data into a single master server for easier administration.
answerOptions.rationale: Blockchain relies on a decentralized, distributed architecture where every node shares identical copies rather than using a single central server.

answerOptions.text: It eliminates the need to install physical sensors on old buildings.
answerOptions.rationale: Physical IoT sensors are still required to capture physical measurements such as tilt and structural cracks.

questions.hint: Reflect on the main security weakness of raw IoT sensor data when verifying data integrity.

questions.question: What defines the primary operation of a Smart Grid in energy management?

answerOptions.text: Combining ICT with the electricity grid to exchange real-time power data between suppliers and consumers.
answerOptions.rationale: Real-time information exchange allows both suppliers and consumers to optimize energy production and consumption efficiently.

answerOptions.text: Replacing all non-renewable power plants strictly with localized solar panels.
answerOptions.rationale: Smart grids integrate diverse energy sources, including conventional power plants, into an interconnected communication network.

answerOptions.text: Automatically shutting off industrial power lines during peak hours to protect residential users.
answerOptions.rationale: Smart grids balance power distribution across all sectors through dynamic monitoring rather than imposing rigid cutoffs on specific users.

answerOptions.text: Storing all excess generated power exclusively in smart home appliances.
answerOptions.rationale: Smart grid networks manage energy flow across the entire grid infrastructure rather than storing power inside household appliances.

questions.hint: Focus on how information technology changes the traditional one-way flow of electricity distribution into a two-way interaction.

questions.question: Which pair of technologies is primarily used in IoT systems to safeguard stored and transmitted data against unauthorized access and hacking?

answerOptions.text: Encryption and Intrusion Detection Systems
answerOptions.rationale: Encryption secures transmitted and stored data contents, while intrusion detection systems monitor and prevent unauthorized network breaches.

answerOptions.text: Actuators and microcontrollers
answerOptions.rationale: Microcontrollers and actuators handle processing and physical outputs rather than providing data security functionality.

answerOptions.text: Relational databases and cloud computing
answerOptions.rationale: Databases and cloud infrastructure provide data storage and management services rather than security defense mechanisms.

answerOptions.text: Motion sensors and light sensors
answerOptions.rationale: Sensors capture physical environmental inputs but do not encrypt network traffic or monitor unauthorized intrusions.

questions.hint: Think about methods used to make data unreadable to unauthorized parties and to detect network intrusions.

questions.question: How does an IoT-enabled Smart Farm automate crop cultivation?

answerOptions.text: By sensing environmental factors like temperature and humidity to automatically trigger watering and climate controls.
answerOptions.rationale: Automated monitoring and control systems manage farming conditions directly, reducing the need for manual agricultural labor.

answerOptions.text: By altering the biological requirement of crops so they no longer need sunlight or water.
answerOptions.rationale: Smart farms regulate and optimize resource delivery rather than changing the fundamental biological needs of plants.

answerOptions.text: By replacing physical fields entirely with virtual simulation software.
answerOptions.rationale: Smart farms cultivate real physical crops using automated technology to sense and adjust ambient growth environments.

answerOptions.text: By forcing farmers to manually record sensor readings into daily logs.
answerOptions.rationale: IoT technology automates both data collection and system actions, eliminating manual record-keeping tasks.

questions.hint: Consider how sensors and control systems interact to maintain environmental factors like humidity and temperature.

questions.question: Which statement accurately describes the structural framework of blockchain technology?

answerOptions.text: Data is grouped into blocks connected in a chain, with all connected computing systems maintaining identical copies.
answerOptions.rationale: Decentralized ledger copies updated across multiple systems ensure high reliability, security, and transparent data history.

answerOptions.text: A single central server stores all blocks and dictates updates to connected clients.
answerOptions.rationale: Blockchain operates without a central server by distributing identical ledger copies to all participating systems on the network.

answerOptions.text: Any user on the network can alter historical block data without authentication.
answerOptions.rationale: Cryptographic authentication and network consensus prevent unauthorized modifications or tampering of stored block data.

answerOptions.text: Information is updated only when connected devices are completely disconnected from the network.
answerOptions.rationale: Network devices simultaneously maintain and update shared information values in real time while connected.

questions.hint: Recall how data is grouped, chained together, and distributed among participants in a blockchain network.

questions.question: What is the defining function of an actuator (driving device) within a physical computing environment?

answerOptions.text: Operating physically in response to control signals sent by a microcontroller.
answerOptions.rationale: Actuators convert electrical commands from the microcontroller into mechanical motion or physical actions in the real world.

answerOptions.text: Gathering ambient information like light and temperature from the physical environment.
answerOptions.rationale: Gathering environmental measurements is the role of input sensors rather than physical driving units.

answerOptions.text: Storing structured sensor data systematically for long-term database management.
answerOptions.rationale: Structured data storage is handled by database and cloud storage technologies.

answerOptions.text: Transmitting encrypted network packets over the internet.
answerOptions.rationale: Data transmission across networks is managed by communication devices and networking protocols.

questions.hint: Think about which component creates physical motion or state changes in the real world.

questions.question: Which service represents a key application of IoT in Smart Healthcare?

answerOptions.text: Continuously monitoring personal metrics like heart rate to enable remote diagnosis and care.
answerOptions.rationale: Wearables track vital signs in real time and sync with healthcare centers, allowing doctors to assess and prescribe remotely.

answerOptions.text: Automatically performing surgical operations without physician supervision.
answerOptions.rationale: Smart healthcare supports monitoring, data collection, and remote consultations, but does not perform autonomous surgeries without doctors.

answerOptions.text: Preventing all genetic diseases through automated smart home lighting.
answerOptions.rationale: IoT healthcare monitors physiological health metrics rather than altering genetic conditions through environmental lighting.

answerOptions.text: Restricting patient data collection strictly to periodic annual hospital visits.
answerOptions.rationale: Smart healthcare continuously gathers health metrics in real time during daily life rather than relying solely on hospital visits.

questions.hint: Consider how wearable devices communicate health status to medical professionals outside the clinic.

questions.question: Which capability illustrates the practical implementation of IoT in a Smart Building?

answerOptions.text: Utilizing automated access control, sensor-based energy management, and real-time smart parking guidance.
answerOptions.rationale: Smart buildings integrate security sensors, automated HVAC/lighting controls, and parking space tracking to maximize efficiency.

answerOptions.text: Requiring security guards to manually monitor and record available parking spots on paper.
answerOptions.rationale: Sensors detect parking spot occupancy in real time and automatically notify drivers via digital displays or applications.

answerOptions.text: Turning off all security and fire detection systems during non-operational hours to save power.
answerOptions.rationale: Automated intrusion and fire detection systems operate continuously to ensure building safety at all times.

answerOptions.text: Eliminating climate control systems in favor of manual window adjustments by occupants.
answerOptions.rationale: Smart buildings use environmental sensors to automatically adjust heating, cooling, and carbon dioxide/gas levels.

questions.hint: Think about how building management automates parking guidance, security, and energy consumption.
